title: Requirement/capability/capacity evidence binding
summary: v0.6 binds API route requirements into requirementDigest, API-egress/online state into capabilityDigest, rejects same-generation equivocation, bounds lease expiry by capacity observation freshness and re-verifies owner/policy/capability/capacity digests independently.
invariants: Identical same-generation repeats are idempotent; different evidence at same generation is equivocation and rejected.
Renewal cannot outlive the capacity observation used to justify it.
